objective: fixed four-bank monthly 60-session momentum Top2, portfolio allocation by causal inverse 20-session volatility

signal_rule.signal: first observed session of each calendar month at T close
signal_rule.selection: same fixed 60-session adjusted-close return Top2 ranking as V4
signal_rule.allocation: selected two banks weighted proportional to inverse sample std of 20 adjusted-close daily simple returns through the signal day, weights sum to 1
signal_rule.execution: T+1 open; final lifecycle exit at closing price; audited cash-only ledger; 100-share lots, 1% prior signal-day amount capacity, one-price limit locks, 3bp slippage, commission/transfer/sell stamp fees
signal_rule.interpretation: relative benchmark gains are sample-window strategy comparisons; strict matched friction is same-holdings gross reference minus trading costs/slippage and is not selection alpha

price_loader: parquet filters only four bank codes and reads price plus amount; no model/features loaded
